pages.quiz:
GERMAN — MOCK EXAM #20
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: GERMAN
TIME ALLOWED: 90 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 80
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A classmate asks "Wie heißt du?" What is being asked? (1 mark)
   A. Where you live
   B. Your name
   C. Your age
   D. How you feel

2. What does "Nein" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. good morning
   B. very good
   C. no
   D. please

3. What does "der Montag" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. Monday
   B. Saturday
   C. Thursday
   D. day

4. If today is Freitag, what is tomorrow? (1 mark)
   A. Donnerstag
   B. Sonntag
   C. Samstag
   D. Montag

5. What is the "ch" sound like in "Kuchen"? (1 mark)
   A. sh as in ship
   B. k as in cake
   C. a breathy sound at the back of the throat
   D. ts as in cats

6. Which birthday wish means "All the best for your birthday"? (1 mark)
   A. Gute Nacht!
   B. Guten Appetit!
   C. Auf Wiedersehen!
   D. Alles Gute zum Geburtstag!

7. What does "die Wassermelone" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. watermelon
   B. egg
   C. carrot
   D. banana

8. What does "gern" mean? (1 mark)
   A. because
   B. often
   C. gladly
   D. never

9. What does "Was ist das?" ask? (1 mark)
   A. How is that?
   B. Who is that?
   C. What is that?
   D. Where is that?

10. Which body word contains the letter ß? (1 mark)
   A. Kopf
   B. Fuß
   C. Hand
   D. Bein

11. Which sentence is a question? (1 mark)
   A. Sie ist nett.
   B. Er ist groß.
   C. Wer ist das?
   D. Das ist mein Vater.

12. What does "die Tante" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. sister
   B. daughter
   C. aunt
   D. family

13. What does "der Teller" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. chair
   B. plate
   C. radio
   D. knife

14. What is the plural of "der Freund"? (1 mark)
   A. die Freunde
   B. die Freunds
   C. die Freunden
   D. die Freunder

15. Which German word is the number 6? (1 mark)
   A. fünf
   B. drei
   C. null
   D. sechs

16. Which German word is the number 1? (1 mark)
   A. elf
   B. eins
   C. fünf
   D. zehn

17. What does "der Fisch" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. mango
   B. fish
   C. tea
   D. orange

18. What does "die Mango" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. mango
   B. potato
   C. cabbage or kale
   D. water

19. What does "das Mittagessen" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. lunch
   B. milk
   C. apple
   D. potato

20. What does "braune Augen" mean? (1 mark)
   A. brown shoes
   B. brown eyes
   C. blue sky
   D. black hair

21. Which special letter is in "fleißig"? (1 mark)
   A. ö
   B. ü
   C. ä
   D. ß

22. Which German word or phrase means "brother"? (1 mark)
   A. der Bruder
   B. die Familie
   C. die Schwester
   D. der Freund

23. Which little word goes with the noun "Teller"? (1 mark)
   A. die
   B. das
   C. der
   D. den

24. Which German word or phrase means "clock"? (1 mark)
   A. der Stuhl
   B. der Topf
   C. die Uhr
   D. das Sofa

25. Which German word or phrase means "Friday"? (1 mark)
   A. der Freitag
   B. der Mittwoch
   C. das Wochenende
   D. der Montag

26. What do you hear in a word if it is spelled "ei"? (1 mark)
   A. the sound ow
   B. the sound oy
   C. the sound eye
   D. the sound ee

27. What does "Juni" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. June
   B. March
   C. April
   D. February

28. Which German word means "March"? (month) (1 mark)
   A. März
   B. Januar
   C. November
   D. Februar

29. Which German word or phrase means "sugar"? (1 mark)
   A. der Kohl
   B. die Kartoffel
   C. der Zucker
   D. der Saft

30. Which verb means "blows" in "Der Wind ___"? (1 mark)
   A. regnet
   B. scheint
   C. weht
   D. schneit

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
31. Write the German sound for each letter group: ei and ie. Give an example word for each. (2 marks)

32. Spell the name "Zawadi" using German letter names. (3 marks)

33. Explain what the colon, the question mark and the exclamation mark tell us when reading aloud. (3 marks)

34. Write four short German sentences that a child could say about his or her birthday. (4 marks)

35. Read: "Mein Vater heißt Juma. Er ist groß und nett." Write three facts from the text in English. (3 marks)

36. Write two sentences in German to say where family members are at home. (3 marks)

37. Write the German words with der, die or das for: cloud, cake, toe. (3 marks)

38. Write three German sentences that say where things are in a house, using im or in der. (3 marks)

39. Unscramble and write with der, die or das: NUMD and ESAN. (4 marks)

40. Write three sentences in German about your father or mother: name, age and one adjective. (3 marks)

41. Say the three time words heute, morgen and gestern in English and give one German sentence with one of them. (3 marks)

42. Write the German words with der, die or das for: cupboard or wardrobe, weather, back. (3 marks)

43. Explain when we use dem and when we use der after a position word like auf or neben. (3 marks)

44. Write three sentences about what you do on three different days. Start each with "Am". (3 marks)

45. Write the German words with der, die or das for: supper, shower, bean, fork. (4 marks)

46. Write the German names of these months: October, November, December. (3 marks)
pages.answers:
GERMAN — MOCK EXAM #20 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. B — Your name
   Wie heißt du? means What is your name?

2. C — no
   Nein means no.

3. A — Monday
   der Montag means Monday.

4. C — Samstag
   After Freitag comes Samstag.

5. C — a breathy sound at the back of the throat
   After u the ch is a scratchy breath sound.

6. D — Alles Gute zum Geburtstag!
   Alles Gute zum Geburtstag is the usual birthday wish.

7. A — watermelon
   die Wassermelone means watermelon.

8. C — gladly
   gern means with pleasure, gladly.

9. C — What is that?
   was means what.

10. B — Fuß
   Fuß has ß.

11. C — Wer ist das?
   Only Wer ist das? asks something.

12. C — aunt
   die Tante means aunt.

13. B — plate
   der Teller means plate.

14. A — die Freunde
   The plural of der Freund is die Freunde.

15. D — sechs
   6 in German is sechs.

16. B — eins
   1 in German is eins.

17. B — fish
   der Fisch means fish.

18. A — mango
   die Mango means mango.

19. A — lunch
   das Mittagessen means lunch.

20. B — brown eyes
   braun = brown and Augen = eyes.

21. D — ß
   fleißig has ß.

22. A — der Bruder
   brother in German is der Bruder.

23. C — der
   It is der Teller, so the little word is der.

24. C — die Uhr
   clock in German is die Uhr.

25. A — der Freitag
   Friday in German is der Freitag.

26. C — the sound eye
   ei sounds like eye.

27. A — June
   Juni means June.

28. A — März
   March in German is März.

29. C — der Zucker
   sugar in German is der Zucker.

30. C — weht
   Der Wind weht means the wind blows.

SECTION B
----
31. (2 marks)
   Answer: ei sounds like eye (nein). ie sounds like ee (Tier).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct sound with an example.

32. (3 marks)
   Answer: Z (tset), A (ah), W (vay), A (ah), D (day), I (ee).
   Working / marking points: 3 marks if all letter names are correct; 2 marks for four or five; 1 mark for two or three.

33. (3 marks)
   Answer: The colon announces a list or speech, the question mark tells us to raise the voice and the exclamation mark shows strong feeling.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each mark.

34. (4 marks)
   Answer: For example: Ich bin heute zehn. Ich habe einen Kuchen. Meine Familie ist da. Alles Gute zum Geburtstag!
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct sentence.

35. (3 marks)
   Answer: The father is called Juma. He is tall. He is kind.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each fact.

36. (3 marks)
   Answer: For example: Mama ist in der Küche. Papa ist im Wohnzimmer.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each sentence and 1 mark for correct in der / im.

37. (3 marks)
   Answer: die Wolke, der Kuchen, der Zeh.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (3 marks).

38. (3 marks)
   Answer: For example: Das Bett ist im Schlafzimmer. Der Tisch ist in der Küche. Das Sofa ist im Wohnzimmer.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct sentence.

39. (4 marks)
   Answer: der Mund and die Nase.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word and 1 mark for each article.

40. (3 marks)
   Answer: For example: Meine Mutter heißt Neema. Sie ist 35 Jahre alt. Sie ist nett.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct sentence.

41. (3 marks)
   Answer: heute = today, morgen = tomorrow, gestern = yesterday. For example: Heute ist Montag.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the three meanings, 1 mark for a correct sentence, 1 mark for capital letters.

42. (3 marks)
   Answer: der Schrank, das Wetter, der Rücken.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (3 marks).

43. (3 marks)
   Answer: dem with der and das nouns (dem Tisch, dem Bett) and der with die nouns (der Tür).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for dem with der nouns, 1 mark for dem with das nouns, 1 mark for der with die nouns.

44. (3 marks)
   Answer: For example: Am Montag gehe ich zur Schule. Am Samstag spiele ich Fußball. Am Sonntag gehe ich in die Kirche.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each sentence with a capital letter, verb in second place and a full stop.

45. (4 marks)
   Answer: das Abendessen, die Dusche, die Bohne, die Gabel.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (4 marks).

46. (3 marks)
   Answer: Oktober, November, Dezember.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correctly spelled month with a capital letter.
